summary: Zamboanga City 2nd District representative with 18 principal-authored bills. Authored an anti-dynasty ban and travel-tax abolition; one issue per dimension. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
